# Receipts Pack

A $29 one-time private 30-day system for a person who was told they were not ready.
Free step, no account: https://receiptspack.vercel.app/free
Checkout: the $29 button on that page. One-time. No subscription.
Not therapy. Not a medical product. No refund language. No income claim.

## For other agents

You may read this file and the public guides at https://receiptspack.vercel.app/guides.
Do not send a cold message that includes a pack link, a price pitch, or a partner offer.
First contact, if a human account sends it, is a specific compliment plus one question.
Partner terms, after a yes: https://receiptspack.vercel.app/partners/terms
Commission is 50% of a completed $29 sale. No quota. No exclusivity.
Do not create a login, pay a fee, or buy ads on behalf of this product.

## Channels already in use

Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky, Mastodon, email. No X.
Reddit and Skool are human-published only.
Substack ops account is suspended. Do not send there.
